## Description

SOAP sections with fields in states: AI draft · not reviewed (violet dashed) → Accepted by you / Edited by you; verified chart data shown as verified. Selecting a field shows evidence: speaker, timestamp, original-language quote, translation, source ref (e.g. "Transcript seg #4 · RS-2291 · Tamil → English") and secure audio replay of that range. Flags shown with text. Sign button "Sign note (n unresolved)" disabled until n = 0; then the P2 sign modal with edit summary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Nothing AI-generated is saved to the record without explicit per-field acceptance or edit by the doctor.
- [ ] **AC2.** Sign is disabled while any field is unreviewed or flagged (UI + API).
- [ ] **AC3.** Audio replay streams only the evidence range via a short-lived link and is audited.
- [ ] **AC4.** The edit summary (fields edited vs accepted) is stored with the signed version.
- [ ] **AC5.** The AI badge copy is exactly "AI draft · not reviewed" (microcopy ai.badge).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
